'''Holleen Mecandes''' is a [[Cairhien|Cairhienin]] noblewoman, known as '''the Kite'''.

==Appearance==
She is blonde, statuesque, and was in her forties at the time of the events of the main series.

==History==
She is the much younger sister, or more likely the niece, of [[Cabriana Mecandes]], an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]]. At some point, her branch of the family relocated from Tear to Cairhien.

Lady Holleen is the head of the largest [[Darkfriend]] cell in Cairhien.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
